name: Slackify Note (fork)
description: Fork of Slackify Note by Jeremy Overman. Adds two Slack-composer-paste fixes: decodes & back to & (slackify-markdown escapes it for Slack's API, where it shows up literally on paste), and strips the zero-width spaces slackify-markdown wraps around *bold*/_italic_ markers, which otherwise stop Slack rendering the formatting. < and > escaping is retained for Slack link/mention syntax.
author: Jeremy Overman (fork: Jim Carroll)
